detection_noise.model: Irwin-Hall sum of four uniforms per box coordinate

pixel_convention: continuous original-frame pixels: pixel (i, j) spans [i, i+1) x [j, j+1) and the top-left pixel centre is (0.5, 0.5); OpenCV puts that centre at (0, 0), so an OpenCV principal point is (cx - 0.5, cy - 0.5)
scope: SYNTHETIC analytic fixture: validates math and plumbing only; it is not perception, tracking, forecasting or geometry performance evidence

availability_reason.heading_deg: speed below 1e-09 px/s: image heading is undefined
